claude.rationale: gap_45=1: the customer-facing assets (T4) — 89 retail properties, 2.5M sq ft acquired into the REIT's title-holding subsidiaries — crossed the ownership boundary, but the operational processes that acquire and manage them (T5) did NOT transfer; they "reside with affiliates of its external sponsor" (Cole Realty Advisors under property-management/leasing agreements), so the deliverable is owned while the delivering process is only accessed, not owned (read-only). gap_56=1: T6 is null — "We have no paid employees and are externally advised and managed by CR IV Advisors" — so the operating processes run without any in-house organization/people transferring alongside; the people performing acquisition and property management are the advisor's affiliates. gap_mitigated=yes: the shared operating substrate is contractually absorbed at closing via "advisory and property-management/leasing agreements with our subsidiaries that hold title to our properties," an operating-agreement allocation of the shared substrate.

gemini.rationale: The company acquires real estate assets (T4) but has no internal operations or employees. The processes to acquire and manage the properties (T5) and the people performing them (T6) reside with the external advisor and its affiliates, creating a structural gap between the assets and the processes/people. This gap is mitigated by advisory and property management agreements with the external advisor.

openai.rationale: The registrant acquired and owned 89 retail properties, while property-management, leasing, acquisition, and administrative processes remained with CR IV Advisors and Cole Realty Advisors rather than crossing into the employee-less registrant. This product-process separation establishes gap_45, but property-management and leasing agreements with the title-holding subsidiaries contractually bridged the external operating substrate at closing. Gap_56 is 0 because both the operating processes and the people performing them remained coherently colocated within the advisor affiliates.
